item.title: After a president-filled celebration, Rev. Jesse Jackson’s family gathers for intimate final goodbye

Jesse Jackson Sr., the family and friends who knew him best hosted a more intimate gathering Saturday to grieve the civil rights leader at his organization's headquarters.
